reason: A pre-install diagnostic tool that checks local DSH package versions, repository accessibility, bundle metadata, build entrypoints, and peer dependency compatibility before installing another plugin.

summaries.zh: 在安装 DSH 插件前检查本地版本、仓库状态、构建入口和 peer 依赖兼容性，并生成体检报告。
summaries.en: Checks local versions, repository status, build entrypoints, and peer dependency compatibility before installing a DSH plugin, then generates a diagnostic report.

capabilities: Reads local DSH-related package versions through the filesystem service
Fetches repository metadata through the DSH web service
Checks peer dependency semver compatibility and reports installation readiness
